Chapter 7114: Greetings, Order Lord

Chapter 7114: Greetings, Order Lord

“Who are you? Are you an immortal? Why are you here?” She asked in astonishment.

She understood he was at least an immortal above the first stage.

“Just coming to take something from Chongming Palace.” He smiled.

“Trespassing?!” Her expression darkened as she became overwhelmed with scenarios. She wondered how she could get away from this powerful foe and warn the others.

The palace was the holy ground of Chong Firmament, eternal and hallowed. They were ready to throw their lives to stop any intruder.

“Trespassing? No, I have the right.” Li Qiye smiled and summoned the Chongming Order.

She appeared to be struck by lightning upon seeing the supreme order. There was only one in the possession of their immortal lord.

It rarely appeared because the lord could communicate with anyone telepathically or through other means. Thus, the order's appearance was significant and symbolic. Seeing it was the same as seeing their immortal lord.

She could tell that this was the real thing. It didn’t matter how it came into his possession, she must obey all orders.

“Bam!” She prostrated and said respectfully: “Greetings, Immortal Lord.”

“Rise.” Li Qiye nodded.

She stood up and had many questions. Nonetheless, she swallowed them out of respect.

“Take me to the palace if there is nothing else.” He ordered.

She glanced at the sky and hesitated briefly before bowing: “Please come to the divine realm so we can properly greet you first, Young Noble.”

“Afraid that my order is fake?” He asked.

“Young Noble, you are our leader now, we will welcome and obey your orders.” She said with an awkward expression.

Taking Li Qiye to the palace was too risky. Thus, she wanted the others to see him first; perhaps they would have a way to extract more information.

“Fine, I do have some time.” He didn’t care for her plan but agreed anyway.

“Thank you, Young Noble.” She said before blowing a horn.

“Ooo-” The horn echoed across the firmament.

“The lord is back?” Everyone paid keen attention.

“No, it’s the order’s holder.” An ancestor said: “Tell everyone to gather right now.”

In just a short time, all the dragon servants received the command.

“Who has the order?” They grew nervous when their lord was sealed and had gone missing. Now, someone was here with the order?

Flowers and springs appeared in the sky of the divine realm. Rainbow bridges connected to the mortal world.

“Rumble!” Golden chariots left indelible marks above. Emperors, ancient ancestors, and overlords descended to the mortal world.

Auspicious clouds and divine auras permeated the land - all to greet Li Qiye.

“Greetings Order Lord, please return with us to the divine realm.” Divine bridges paved the sky, leading directly to the next region.

Only the strongest dragon servants stood closest to Li Qiye, showing the highest level of reverence.

Li Qiye smiled and boarded a carriage, enjoying a new entourage of overlords and many more cultivators.
